items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: I joined Earl about 1931 at the Grand Terrace Cafe then.

ctx.x: Can you tell a bit about Heinz band when you were in quite a long time?

I joined Earl around 1931. I joined Earl about 1931 at the Grand Terrace Cafe then. A nightclub with a floor show. So we had to play dance music and also play music for the show. So anyone that wasn't familiar with reading music, there was no place for him in the band. Because we had to play show music. Sometimes we'd play part of an overture for a dance routine for the chorus. Of course, part of an overture like William Tell, a light cavalry, in the floor show. So if a musician couldn't read then he was lost,…
You traveled in front of the time too.
